AWPTCM-T43858.objective:
• BGPv4 peering establishes successfully to the Established state.
  • BGPv4 learns and installs routes from Update messages.
  • BGPv4 unicast traffic passes through the scenario at line rate as expected.
  • BGPv4 status and functionality are correct under unicast traffic load.

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability.
Run background unicast traffic in the relevant BGPv4 scenario. Verify that traffic passes through the scenario at line rate as expected.
Verify BGPv4 establishes to Established state, learns routes from Updates, and forwards unicast traffic correctly.
